newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up eight cents to 14.27 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up eight cents to 14.27 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose eight cents to 14.27 ringgit ($5.67) a kg in tandem with a slight rise overnight on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The LME ended up and pushed buying on the KLTM (Kuala Lumpur Tin Market)," said a trader.

Initial bids outnumbered offers by 188 tonnes to 107. Turnover rose to 127 tonnes from 91 on Wednesday and was absorbed by Japanese, European and local interests. The local premium over London swelled to $90 from $60.
